translations.literal: Thereupon Vice Minister of Personnel Ye Sheng inspected the frontier, and together with Grand Coordinator of Yan–Sui Yu Zijun and Yue discussed building the frontier wall and establishing watch platforms and forts.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister Ye Sheng then toured the frontier and, with Grand Coordinator Yu Zijun of Yan–Sui and Wang Yue, planned the frontier wall and its watchtowers and forts.

sentences.zh: 冬，敵入塞，參將錢亮敗績，越等不能救。

translations.literal: In winter the enemy entered the passes; Regiment Commander Qian Liang was defeated, and Yue and the others could not save him.
translations.idiomatic: That winter the enemy crossed the passes; Regiment Commander Qian Liang was defeated before Yue and the others could relieve him.

sentences.zh: 兵部尚書白圭請擇遣大將軍專事敵，會盛還，越亦赴京計事，乃集廷議，請大發兵搜套。

translations.literal: Minister of War Bai Gui asked that a grand general be chosen and sent to deal exclusively with the enemy; when Sheng returned and Yue also came to the capital on business, court discussion was convened and a great mobilization to sweep the Loop was requested.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of War Bai Gui asked for a supreme commander devoted to the enemy; when Ye Sheng returned and Wang Yue came to court, the court met and called for a major expedition to clear the Ordos.

sentences.zh: 帝以武靖侯趙輔為將軍，節制諸路，王越仍督師。

translations.literal: The emperor made Marquis of Wujing Zhao Fu general, with authority over all routes; Wang Yue continued to command the army.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor made Marquis of Wujing Zhao Fu supreme commander over all routes while Wang Yue retained field command.

sentences.zh: 敵大入延綏，輔不能御，遂召還，以寧晉伯劉聚代之，聚亦未有功。

translations.literal: The enemy raided Yan–Sui in force; Fu could not repel them, so he was recalled and replaced by Marquis of Ningjin Liu Ju, who also achieved nothing.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy overran Yan–Sui; Zhao Fu failed to stop them and was recalled, and his replacement Liu Ju achieved nothing either.

sentences.zh: 而毛裡孩、孛魯乃、斡羅出稍衰，滿都魯入河套稱可汗，加思蘭為太師。

translations.literal: Meanwhile Maolihai, Belunai, and Oloroo gradually declined; Manduul entered the Ordos and styled himself khan, and Boluosilan became grand preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: As Maolihai, Belunai, and Oloroo waned, Manduul entered the Ordos as khan and Boluosilan became grand preceptor.

sentences.zh: 九年秋，滿都魯等與孛羅忽並寇韋州。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the ninth year Manduul and others together with Beluohu raided Weizhou.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn Manduul and Beluohu jointly raided Weizhou.

sentences.zh: 王越偵知敵盡行，其老弱巢紅鹽池，乃與許寧及游擊周玉率輕騎晝夜疾馳至，分薄其營，前後夾擊，大破之。

translations.literal: Wang Yue learned by reconnaissance that the enemy had all gone out and that their old and weak had nested at Hongyan Lake; he then with Xu Ning and Regiment Commander Zhou Yu led light horsemen day and night at full speed, divided to press their camp, and attacked front and rear, routing them completely.
translations.idiomatic: Learning the enemy had left their camp, Wang Yue raced with Xu Ning and Regiment Commander Zhou Yu to Hongyan Lake, where the old and weak remained; they split their forces, struck from both sides, and won a crushing victory.

sentences.zh: 復邀擊於韋州。

translations.literal: They again intercepted and attacked them at Weizhou.
translations.idiomatic: They ambushed the enemy again at Weizhou.

sentences.zh: 滿都魯等敗歸，孳畜廬帳蕩盡，妻孥皆喪亡，相顧悲哭去。

translations.literal: Manduul and the others fled back in defeat; livestock, tents, and herds were utterly swept away, wives and children all lost; they looked at one another in grief and weeping and departed.
translations.idiomatic: Manduul and his men fled in defeat, losing their herds, tents, wives, and children; they wept as they withdrew.

sentences.zh: 自是不復居河套，邊患少弭；

translations.literal: From this time they no longer dwelt in the Ordos, and frontier trouble somewhat eased;
translations.idiomatic: They never again settled in the Ordos, and the frontier crisis eased somewhat;

sentences.zh: 間盜邊，弗敢大入，亦數遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: they occasionally plundered the border but did not dare enter in force, and also repeatedly sent envoys to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: though they still skirmished on the border they dared not invade in force, and sent tribute envoys repeatedly.

sentences.zh: 初，加思蘭以女妻滿都魯，立為可汗。

translations.literal: At first Boluosilan gave his daughter in marriage to Manduul and set him up as khan.
translations.idiomatic: Boluosilan had married his daughter to Manduul and made him khan.

sentences.zh: 久之殺孛羅忽，並其眾，益專恣。

translations.literal: After a long time he killed Beluohu and absorbed his followers, growing ever more arbitrary in power.
translations.idiomatic: In time he killed Beluohu, absorbed his followers, and grew ever more domineering.

sentences.zh: 滿都魯部脫羅干、亦思馬因謀殺之。

translations.literal: Toraghan and Ismayin of Manduul’s tribe plotted to kill him.
translations.idiomatic: Toraghan and Ismayin of Manduul’s tribe plotted his murder.

sentences.zh: 尋滿都魯亦死，諸強酋相繼略盡，邊人稍得息肩。

translations.literal: Before long Manduul also died; the powerful chiefs were successively largely gone, and frontier people slightly gained relief.
translations.idiomatic: Manduul soon died as well; one strong chief after another disappeared, and the frontier people breathed a little easier.

sentences.zh: 時中官汪直怙恩用事，思以邊功自樹，王越、硃永附之。

translations.literal: At this time the eunuch Wang Zhi relied on imperial favor and held power, seeking to build himself up through frontier achievement; Wang Yue and Zhu Yong attached themselves to him.
translations.idiomatic: Eunuch Wang Zhi, favored and powerful, sought glory on the frontier; Wang Yue and Zhu Yong followed him.

sentences.zh: 十六年春，邊將上言，傳聞敵將渡河，遽以永為將軍。

translations.literal: In the spring of the sixteenth year frontier generals reported that the enemy was said to be about to cross the river, and Yong was hastily made general.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year frontier commanders reported a likely river crossing, and Zhu Yong was hurriedly appointed general.

sentences.zh: 直與越督師至邊，未及期，襲敵於威寧海子，大破之，又敗之於大同。

translations.literal: Zhi and Yue supervised the army to the frontier; before the appointed time they surprise-attacked the enemy at Weining Lake, routed them completely, and again defeated them at Datong.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhi and Wang Yue reached the frontier and, ahead of schedule, routed the enemy at Weining Lake and again at Datong.

sentences.zh: 永晉公爵，予世襲，越封威寧伯，直增祿至三百石。

translations.literal: Yong was promoted to duke with hereditary title, Yue was ennobled Marquis of Weining, and Zhi’s stipend was raised to three hundred shi.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Yong was made duke with a hereditary title, Wang Yue was made Marquis of Weining, and Wang Zhi’s stipend rose to three hundred shi.

sentences.zh: 未幾，詔以越代永總兵。

translations.literal: Before long an edict made Yue replace Yong as commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Wang Yue replaced Zhu Yong as commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 於是亦思馬因等益糾眾盜邊，延及遼塞。

translations.literal: Thereupon Ismayin and others increasingly gathered followers to plunder the border, extending the trouble to the Liao frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Ismayin and others then raided the border more often, reaching the Liao frontier.

sentences.zh: 秋，敵三萬騎寇大同，連營五十里，殺掠人畜數萬。

translations.literal: In autumn thirty thousand enemy horsemen raided Datong, camped in a line fifty li long, and killed and plundered tens of thousands of people and livestock.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn thirty thousand horsemen overran Datong in a fifty-li camp line, killing and looting tens of thousands of people and animals.

sentences.zh: 總兵許寧御之，兵敗，以捷聞。

translations.literal: Commander-in-Chief Xu Ning met them, was defeated in battle, yet reported victory.
translations.idiomatic: Commander Xu Ning met them, was beaten, and falsely reported victory.

sentences.zh: 敵既得利，長驅入順聖川，散掠渾源、朔諸州。

translations.literal: Having gained their profit, the enemy drove deep into Shunsheng River valley and scattered in raids on Hunyuan, Shuo, and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Emboldened by their gains, they drove into the Shunsheng valley and scattered raids across Hunyuan, Shuo, and neighboring prefectures.

sentences.zh: 宣府巡撫秦紘、總兵周玉力戰卻之。

translations.literal: Grand Coordinator of Xuanfu Qin Hong and Commander-in-Chief Zhou Yu fought hard and drove them back.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coordinator Qin Hong of Xuanfu and Commander Zhou Yu fought hard and drove them back.

sentences.zh: 山西巡撫邊鏞，參將支玉等悉力捍禦，敵去輒復來，迄成化末無寧歲。

translations.literal: Grand Coordinator of Shanxi Bian Yong, Regiment Commander Zhi Yu, and others defended with all their strength; the enemy left only to return, and until the end of Chenghua there was no peaceful year.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coordinator Bian Yong of Shanxi, Regiment Commander Zhi Yu, and others fought hard in defense, but the raiders kept returning; until Chenghua ended there was no quiet year.

sentences.zh: 亦思馬因死，入寇者復稱小王子，又有伯顏猛可王。

translations.literal: When Ismayin died, the raiders again styled themselves the Little Prince, and there was also Bayan Mongke Wang.
translations.idiomatic: After Ismayin died the raiders again marched under the name of the Little Prince, joined by Bayan Mongke Wang.

sentences.zh: 弘治元年夏，小王子奉書求貢，自稱大元大可汗。

translations.literal: In the summer of the first year of Hongzhi the Little Prince sent a letter begging to offer tribute, styling himself Great Khan of the Great Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of Hongzhi one the Little Prince petitioned for tribute, calling himself Great Khan of the Great Yuan.

sentences.zh: 朝廷方務優容，許之。

translations.literal: The court was then intent on forbearance and granted this.
translations.idiomatic: The court, favoring conciliation, agreed.

sentences.zh: 自是，與伯顏猛可王等屢入貢，漸往來套中，出沒為寇。

translations.literal: From this time he and Bayan Mongke Wang and others repeatedly presented tribute, gradually moving back and forth in the Loop, appearing and vanishing as raiders.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter he and Bayan Mongke Wang sent tribute repeatedly while moving through the Ordos, raiding whenever they chose.

sentences.zh: 八年，北部亦卜剌因王等入套駐牧。

translations.literal: In the eighth year Yibulai Wang and others of the northern tribes entered the Loop to pasture.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year Yibulai Wang and other northern chiefs entered the Ordos to pasture.

sentences.zh: 於是小王子及脫羅干之子火篩相倚日強，為東西諸邊患。

translations.literal: Thereupon the Little Prince and Toraghan’s son Huosai, relying on each other, grew daily stronger and became a trouble to all eastern and western frontiers.
translations.idiomatic: The Little Prince and Huosai, son of Toraghan, grew stronger together and plagued the eastern and western frontiers.

sentences.zh: 其年，三入遼東，多殺掠。

translations.literal: That year they entered Liaodong three times, killing and plundering heavily.
translations.idiomatic: That year they raided Liaodong three times with heavy slaughter and looting.

sentences.zh: 明年，宣、大、延綏諸境俱被殘。

translations.literal: The next year the regions of Xuan, Da, and Yan–Sui were all ravaged.
translations.idiomatic: The following year Xuanfu, Datong, and Yan–Sui were all devastated.

sentences.zh: 十一年秋，王越既節制諸邊，乃率輕兵襲敵於賀蘭山後，破之。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the eleventh year, with Wang Yue already exercising control over all frontiers, he led light troops to surprise the enemy behind Helan Mountain and broke them.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn Wang Yue, now commanding all frontiers, led light troops in a surprise attack behind Helan Mountain and routed the enemy.

sentences.zh: 明年，敵擁眾入大同、寧夏境，游擊王杲敗績，參將秦恭、副總兵馬升逗遛不進，皆論死。

translations.literal: The next year the enemy gathered a host and entered the territories of Datong and Ningxia; Regiment Commander Wang Gao was defeated, Regiment Commander Qin Gong and Vice Commander Ma Sheng lingered and did not advance, and all were sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: The next year a large force entered Datong and Ningxia; Regiment Commander Wang Gao was beaten, Qin Gong and Vice Commander Ma Sheng hung back, and all were condemned to death.

sentences.zh: 時平江伯陳銳為總兵，侍郎許進督師，久無功，被劾去，以保國公硃暉、侍郎史琳代之，太監苗逵監軍。

translations.literal: At this time Marquis of Pingjiang Chen Rui was commander-in-chief and Vice Minister Xu Jin supervised the army; after long failure they were impeached and removed, and were replaced by Duke of Protecting the State Zhu Hui and Vice Minister Shi Lin, with Eunuch Miao Kui supervising the army.
translations.idiomatic: Marquis Chen Rui commanded and Vice Minister Xu Jin directed operations, but after prolonged failure both were removed; Duke Zhu Hui and Vice Minister Shi Lin replaced them under eunuch supervisor Miao Kui.

sentences.zh: 十三年冬，小王子復居河套。

translations.literal: In the winter of the thirteenth year the Little Prince again dwelt in the Ordos.
translations.idiomatic: That winter the Little Prince settled in the Ordos again.

sentences.zh: 明年春，吏部侍郎王鏊上御敵八策：一曰定廟算，二曰重主將，三曰嚴法令，四曰恤邊民，五曰廣招募，六曰用間，七曰分兵，八曰出奇。

translations.literal: The next spring Vice Minister of Personnel Wang Ao submitted eight policies for repelling the enemy: first, fix court strategy; second, esteem the commander-in-chief; third, enforce laws and orders strictly; fourth, care for frontier people; fifth, broaden recruitment; sixth, employ spies; seventh, divide forces; eighth, use surprise.
translations.idiomatic: The following spring Vice Minister Wang Ao proposed eight policies: fix strategy at court, empower commanders, enforce discipline, protect frontier people, expand recruitment, use spies, divide forces, and strike by surprise.

sentences.zh: 帝命所司知之。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered the relevant offices to take note.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor had the relevant offices take note.

sentences.zh: 時敵以八千騎東駐遼塞下，攻入長勝堡，殺掠殆盡。

translations.literal: At this time the enemy with eight thousand horsemen encamped east below the Liao frontier, attacked and entered Changsheng Fort, and killed and plundered almost entirely.
translations.idiomatic: Eight thousand horsemen camped below the Liao frontier, stormed Changsheng Fort, and slaughtered and looted almost everyone there.

sentences.zh: 秋，暉等以五路之師夜襲敵於河套，斬首三級，驅孳畜千餘歸，賞甚厚。

translations.literal: In autumn Hui and the others with armies on five routes night-attacked the enemy in the Ordos, took three heads, and drove back more than a thousand head of livestock; the rewards were very generous.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn Zhu Hui sent five columns in a night raid on the Ordos, took three heads, drove off more than a thousand animals, and received lavish rewards.

sentences.zh: 小王子以十萬騎從花馬池、鹽池入，散掠固原、寧夏境，三輔震動，戕殺慘酷。

translations.literal: The Little Prince with one hundred thousand horsemen entered by Huama Pond and Salt Pond, scattered in raids in the territories of Guyuan and Ningxia, shook the Three Adjuncts, and slaughtered with cruel severity.
translations.idiomatic: The Little Prince led one hundred thousand horsemen through Huama and Salt ponds, raided Guyuan and Ningxia, shook the capital region, and slaughtered with terrible cruelty.

sentences.zh: 十五年，以戶部尚書秦紘總制陝西。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year Minister of Revenue Qin Hong was put in overall charge of Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year Minister Qin Hong was placed in overall charge of Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 夏，敵入遼東清河堡，至密雲，旋西掠偏頭關。

translations.literal: In summer the enemy entered Qinghe Fort in Liaodong, reached Miyun, then turned west to plunder Piantou Pass.
translations.idiomatic: That summer raiders entered Qinghe Fort in Liaodong, reached Miyun, then swung west to plunder Piantou Pass.

sentences.zh: 秋，復以五千騎犯遼東長安堡，副總兵劉祥御之，斬首五十一級，敵乃退。

translations.literal: In autumn they again with five thousand horsemen attacked Chang’an Fort in Liaodong; Vice Commander Liu Xiang met them, took fifty-one heads, and the enemy then withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn five thousand horsemen struck Chang’an Fort in Liaodong; Vice Commander Liu Xiang killed fifty-one of them and drove them off.

sentences.zh: 明年，稍靖。

translations.literal: The next year things were somewhat calm.
translations.idiomatic: The following year the frontier quieted somewhat.

sentences.zh: 十七年春，敵上書請貢，許之，竟不至；

translations.literal: In the spring of the seventeenth year the enemy sent a letter requesting tribute; this was granted, yet they never came;
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year they petitioned for tribute and were granted permission, but never came;

sentences.zh: 仍入大同殺墩軍，犯宣府及莊浪，守將衛勇、白玉等御卻之。

translations.literal: they still entered Datong and killed signal-tower troops, struck Xuanfu and Zhuanglang, and defending generals Wei Yong, Bai Yu, and others repelled them.
translations.idiomatic: instead they entered Datong, killed watch-tower garrisons, and struck Xuanfu and Zhuanglang before defenders Wei Yong, Bai Yu, and others drove them back.

sentences.zh: 明年春，敵三萬騎圍靈州，復散掠內地，指揮仇鉞、總兵李祥擊走之。

translations.literal: The next spring thirty thousand enemy horsemen besieged Lingzhou and again scattered in raids in the interior; Commander Qiu Yue and Commander-in-Chief Li Xiang attacked and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: The following spring thirty thousand horsemen besieged Lingzhou and raided the interior; Commander Qiu Yue and Commander Li Xiang drove them off.

sentences.zh: 敵大舉入寇宣府，總兵張俊御之，大敗，裨將張雄、穆榮戰歿。

translations.literal: The enemy invaded Xuanfu in force; Commander-in-Chief Zhang Jun met them, was heavily defeated, and lieutenant generals Zhang Xiong and Mu Rong died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: A major force invaded Xuanfu; Commander Zhang Jun was routed, and lieutenant generals Zhang Xiong and Mu Rong were killed.

sentences.zh: 武宗嗣位，覆命暉、琳出御。

translations.literal: When the Wuzong emperor succeeded to the throne, he again ordered Hui and Lin to go out to repel the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: When the Wuzong emperor succeeded, he again sent Zhu Hui and Shi Lin to the frontier.

sentences.zh: 冬，敵入鎮夷所，指揮劉經死之。

translations.literal: In winter the enemy entered Zhenyi Station; Commander Liu Jing died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: That winter raiders entered Zhenyi Station and Commander Liu Jing was killed.

sentences.zh: 復自花馬池毀垣入，掠隆德、靜寧、會寧諸處，關中大擾，以楊一清為總制。

translations.literal: They again entered by breaking down the wall at Huama Pond, plundered Longde, Jingning, Huining, and other places, greatly disturbed Guanzhong, and Yang Yiqing was made overall commander.
translations.idiomatic: They broke through at Huama Pond, raided Longde, Jingning, and Huining, threw Guanzhong into turmoil, and Yang Yiqing was appointed overall commander.

sentences.zh: 時正德元年春也。

translations.literal: This was the spring of the first year of Zhengde.
translations.idiomatic: It was the spring of Zhengde one.

sentences.zh: 劉瑾用事，監軍皆閹人，一清不得職去，文貴、才寬相繼受事。

translations.literal: Liu Jin held power; army supervisors were all eunuchs; Yiqing left unable to perform his duties, and Wen Gui and Cai Kuan successively took charge.
translations.idiomatic: With Liu Jin in power, eunuchs supervised every army; Yang Yiqing was driven out, and Wen Gui and Cai Kuan took command in turn.

sentences.zh: 二年，敵入寧夏、莊浪及定遼後衛諸境，守將皆逮問。

translations.literal: In the second year the enemy entered the territories of Ningxia, Zhuanglang, and Dingliao Rear Guard; defending generals were all arrested and interrogated.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year raiders entered Ningxia, Zhuanglang, and Dingliao Rear Guard, and the defending commanders were all arrested.

sentences.zh: 四年，敵數寇大同。

translations.literal: In the fourth year the enemy repeatedly raided Datong.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year Datong was raided repeatedly.

sentences.zh: 冬，才寬禦敵於花馬池，中伏死。

translations.literal: In winter Cai Kuan met the enemy at Huama Pond, fell into an ambush, and died.
translations.idiomatic: That winter Cai Kuan met the enemy at Huama Pond, was ambushed, and killed.

sentences.zh: 總兵馬昂與別部亦孛來戰於木瓜山，勝之，斬三百六十五級，獲馬畜六百餘，軍器二千九百餘。

translations.literal: Commander-in-Chief Ma Ang fought Yibolai of another branch at Mugua Mountain, defeated him, took three hundred sixty-five heads, captured more than six hundred horses and livestock, and more than twenty-nine hundred pieces of military equipment.
translations.idiomatic: Commander Ma Ang defeated Yibolai of another branch at Mugua Mountain, taking 365 heads, more than 600 horses and animals, and nearly 2,900 weapons.

sentences.zh: 明年，北部亦卜剌與小王子仇殺。

translations.literal: The next year Yibulai of the northern tribes and the Little Prince feuded and fought each other.
translations.idiomatic: The following year Yibulai of the north and the Little Prince turned on each other.

sentences.zh: 亦卜剌竄西海，阿爾禿廝與合，逼脅洮西屬番，屢入寇。

translations.literal: Yibulai fled to the Western Sea, joined with Aertusi, coerced the dependent tribes west of the Tao River, and repeatedly entered in raids.
translations.idiomatic: Yibulai fled to the Western Sea, allied with Aertusi, bullied the dependent tribes west of the Tao, and raided again and again.

sentences.zh: 巡撫張翼、總兵王勳不能制，漸深入，邊人苦之。

translations.literal: Grand Coordinator Zhang Yi and Commander-in-Chief Wang Xun could not control them; they gradually penetrated deeper, and frontier people suffered bitterly.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coordinator Zhang Yi and Commander Wang Xun could not check them; the raids pushed ever deeper, and the border people suffered.

sentences.zh: 八年夏，擁眾來川，遣使詣翼所，乞邊地駐牧修貢。

translations.literal: In the summer of the eighth year he gathered a host and came to the frontier riverlands, sent envoys to Yi's headquarters, and begged for border land to pasture and restore tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, that summer, he brought a large force into the frontier valleys and sent envoys to Zhang Yi asking for pasturelands and permission to resume tribute.

sentences.zh: 翼啖以金帛，令遠徙，亦卜剌遂西掠烏斯藏，據之。

translations.literal: Yi enticed him with gold and silks and ordered him to move far away; Yibulai then raided west into U-Tsang and occupied it.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yi placated him with gold and silk and told him to move on; Yibulai then swept west into Tibet and seized the region.

sentences.zh: 自是洮、岷、松潘無寧歲。

translations.literal: From this time Tao, Min, and Songpan had no peaceful year.
translations.idiomatic: After that Tao, Min, and Songpan knew no quiet year.

sentences.zh: 小王子數入寇，殺掠尤慘。

translations.literal: The Little Prince repeatedly entered in raids; his killing and plunder were especially cruel.
translations.idiomatic: The Little Prince raided repeatedly, and his slaughter and plunder were especially savage.

sentences.zh: 復以五萬騎攻大同，趣朔州，掠馬邑。

translations.literal: He again with fifty thousand horsemen attacked Datong, pressed toward Shuozhou, and plundered Mayi.
translations.idiomatic: He again led fifty thousand horsemen against Datong, drove toward Shuozhou, and ravaged Mayi.

sentences.zh: 帝命咸寧侯仇鉞總兵御之，戰於萬全衛，斬三級，而所失亡十倍，以捷聞。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Marquis of Xianning Qiu Yue as commander-in-chief to meet them; they fought at Wanquan Guard, took three heads, yet losses were ten times that, and victory was reported.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent Marquis of Xianning Qiu Yue to command the defense; at Wanquan Guard three heads were taken while Ming losses ran ten times higher — yet a victory was announced.

sentences.zh: 明年秋，敵連營數十，寇宣、大塞，而別遣萬騎掠懷安。

translations.literal: The next autumn the enemy made several dozen linked camps, raided the Xuan–Da frontier, and separately dispatched ten thousand horsemen to plunder Huai'an.
translations.idiomatic: The following autumn the raiders pitched dozens of linked camps along the Xuan–Da line while a separate ten thousand horsemen swept Huai'an.

sentences.zh: 總制叢蘭告急，命太監張永督宣、大、延綏兵，都督白玉為大將，協蘭守禦，京師戒嚴。

translations.literal: Overall commander Cong Lan reported in emergency; the emperor ordered eunuch Zhang Yong to supervise Xuan, Da, and Yan–Sui troops, with Chief Commander Bai Yu as grand general to assist Lan in defense; the capital was placed on alert.
translations.idiomatic: Cong Lan sent urgent reports; the court put eunuch Zhang Yong over the Xuan, Da, and Yan–Sui armies, made Chief Commander Bai Yu grand general to help him hold the line, and put the capital on alert.

sentences.zh: 已，敵逾懷安趣蔚州，至平虜城南，蘭等預置毒飯於田間如農家餉，而設伏以待。

translations.literal: Soon the enemy passed Huai'an toward Yuzhou, reaching south of Pinglu town; Lan and others had beforehand placed poisoned food in the fields like peasant rations, and set an ambush to wait.
translations.idiomatic: The raiders then pushed past Huai'an toward Yuzhou and reached the south of Pinglu; Cong Lan's men had already laid poisoned food in the fields disguised as peasant rations and waited in ambush.

sentences.zh: 敵至，中毒，伏猝發，多死者。

translations.literal: When the enemy arrived they were poisoned; the ambush sprang suddenly and many died.
translations.idiomatic: When the raiders arrived they ate the poisoned food; the ambush burst out and many were killed.

sentences.zh: 其年，小王子部長卜兒孩以內難復奔據西海，出沒寇西北邊。

translations.literal: That year the Little Prince's tribal chief Bo'erhai, owing to internal troubles, again fled to occupy the Western Sea, appearing and vanishing to raid the northwest frontier.
translations.idiomatic: That same year the Little Prince's chief Bo'erhai, driven by internal strife, again seized the Western Sea and raided the northwest border in sudden strikes.

sentences.zh: 十一年秋，小王子以七萬騎分道入，與總兵潘浩戰於賈家灣。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the eleventh year the Little Prince with seventy thousand horsemen entered by several routes and fought Commander-in-Chief Pan Hao at Jiajia Bay.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, autumn, the Little Prince split seventy thousand horsemen along several routes and fought Commander Pan Hao at Jiajia Bay.

sentences.zh: 浩再戰再敗，裨將硃春、王唐死之。

translations.literal: Pan Hao fought twice and was twice defeated; lieutenant generals Zhu Chun and Wang Tang died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: Pan Hao fought twice and lost both times; lieutenant generals Zhu Chun and Wang Tang were killed.

sentences.zh: 張永遇於老營坡，被創走居庸。

translations.literal: Zhang Yong met them at Laoying Slope, was wounded, and fled toward Juyong.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yong met them at Laoying Slope, was wounded, and fled toward Juyong Pass.

sentences.zh: 敵遂犯宣府，凡攻破城堡二十，殺掠人畜數萬。

translations.literal: The enemy then struck Xuanfu, altogether storming twenty forts and castles, killing and plundering tens of thousands of people and livestock.
translations.idiomatic: The raiders then overran Xuanfu, taking twenty forts and castles and killing or carrying off tens of thousands of people and animals.

sentences.zh: 浩奪三官，諸將降罰有差。

translations.literal: Pan Hao was stripped of three ranks; the various generals were demoted and punished according to degree.
translations.idiomatic: Pan Hao lost three ranks; the other commanders were demoted and punished to varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 十二年冬，小王子以五萬騎自榆林入寇，圍總兵王勳等於應州。

translations.literal: In the winter of the twelfth year the Little Prince with fifty thousand horsemen raided in from Yulin and besieged Commander-in-Chief Wang Xun and others at Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, winter, the Little Prince came through Yulin with fifty thousand horsemen and besieged Commander Wang Xun at Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 帝幸陽和，親部署，督諸將往援，殊死戰，敵稍卻。

translations.literal: The emperor went to Yanghe, personally deployed forces, and supervised the generals in going to the rescue; they fought desperately and the enemy withdrew somewhat.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor went to Yanghe, took command in person, and sent the generals to the rescue; after desperate fighting the raiders fell back a little.

sentences.zh: 明日復來攻，自辰至酉，戰百餘合，敵引而西，追至平虜、朔州，值大風黑霧，晝晦，帝乃還，命宣捷於朝。

translations.literal: The next day they came to attack again; from chen to you they fought more than a hundred engagements; the enemy withdrew westward; the pursuit reached Pinglu and Shuozhou; encountering great wind and black fog, day turned dark; the emperor then returned and ordered victory proclaimed at court.
translations.idiomatic: The next day the raiders attacked again; from morning to evening more than a hundred clashes were fought before they withdrew west. The pursuit reached Pinglu and Shuozhou, but a gale and black fog blotted out the day; the emperor turned back and ordered victory proclaimed at court.

sentences.zh: 是後歲犯邊，然不敢大入。

translations.literal: After this they raided the frontier yearly, yet did not dare a major incursion.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter they raided the border every year, but no longer dared a deep thrust.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖四年春，以萬騎寇甘肅。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fourth year of Jiajing ten thousand horsemen raided Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of Jiajing four ten thousand horsemen struck Gansu.

sentences.zh: 總兵姜奭御之於苦水墩，斬其魁。

translations.literal: Commander-in-Chief Jiang Yi met them at Kushui mound and beheaded their leader.
translations.idiomatic: Commander Jiang Yi met them at Kushui mound and beheaded their chieftain.

sentences.zh: 明年犯大同及宣府，亦卜剌復駐牧賀蘭山後，數擾邊。

translations.literal: The next year they raided Datong and Xuanfu; Yibulai again pastured behind Mount Helan and repeatedly harassed the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: The following year they hit Datong and Xuanfu; Yibulai settled again to pasture behind Mount Helan and kept harassing the border.

sentences.zh: 明年春，小王子兩寇宣府。

translations.literal: The next spring the Little Prince twice raided Xuanfu.
translations.idiomatic: The next spring the Little Prince struck Xuanfu twice.

sentences.zh: 參將王經、關山先後戰死。

translations.literal: Regimental commanders Wang Jing and Guan Shan died in battle in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Regimental commanders Wang Jing and Guan Shan were killed in turn.

sentences.zh: 秋，以數萬騎犯寧夏塞，尚書王憲以總兵鄭卿等敗之，斬三百餘級。

translations.literal: In autumn tens of thousands of horsemen raided the Ningxia frontier; Minister Wang Xian with Commander-in-Chief Zheng Qing and others defeated them and took more than three hundred heads.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn tens of thousands of horsemen struck the Ningxia line; Minister Wang Xian and Commander Zheng Qing routed them and took more than three hundred heads.

sentences.zh: 明年春，掠山西。

translations.literal: The next spring they plundered Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: The following spring they ravaged Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 夏，入大同中路，參將李蓁御卻之。

translations.literal: In summer they entered the central route of Datong; Regimental Commander Li Zhen repelled them.
translations.idiomatic: That summer they came in through the central Datong route; Regimental Commander Li Zhen drove them back.

sentences.zh: 冬，復寇大同，指揮趙源戰死。

translations.literal: In winter they again raided Datong; Commander Zhao Yuan died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: That winter they raided Datong again; Commander Zhao Yuan was killed.

sentences.zh: 十一年春，小王子乞通貢，未得命，怒，遂擁十萬騎入寇。

translations.literal: In the spring of the eleventh year the Little Prince begged to open tribute relations; when no order came he grew angry and mustered one hundred thousand horsemen to raid.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, spring, the Little Prince asked to resume tribute; denied permission, he flew into a rage and swept in with one hundred thousand horsemen.

sentences.zh: 總制唐龍請許之，帝不聽。

translations.literal: Overall commander Tang Long asked that this be granted; the emperor would not listen.
translations.idiomatic: Overall commander Tang Long urged that the request be granted; the emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 龍連戰，頗有斬獲。

translations.literal: Long fought in succession and took considerable heads and captives.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Long fought battle after battle and won a fair number of heads and captives.

sentences.zh: 時小王子最富強，控弦十餘萬，多畜貨貝，稍厭兵，乃徙幕東方，稱土蠻，分諸部落在西北邊者甚眾。

translations.literal: At this time the Little Prince was strongest and richest, commanding more than one hundred thousand bowmen and hoarding much goods and wealth; somewhat weary of war, he moved his yurt eastward, styled himself Tumen, and divided the many tribes along the northwest frontier.
translations.idiomatic: The Little Prince was then at his strongest, with more than one hundred thousand bowmen and great stores of wealth; growing weary of war, he shifted his camp eastward, took the name Tumen, and split the many tribes along the northwest border.

sentences.zh: 曰吉囊、曰俺答者，於小王子為從父行，據河套，雄黠喜兵，為諸部長，相率躪諸邊。

translations.literal: One called Jinang and one called Anda were the Little Prince's father's cousins; holding the Ordos, bold, cunning, and fond of war, they became chiefs of the tribes and led one another in trampling the frontiers.
translations.idiomatic: Jinang and Anda, the Little Prince's father's cousins, held the Ordos; bold, shrewd, and eager for war, they became tribal chiefs and led one another in overrunning the borders.

sentences.zh: 十二年春，吉囊擁眾屯套內，將犯延綏，邊臣有備，乃突以五萬騎渡河西，襲亦不剌、卜兒孩兩部，大破之。

translations.literal: In the spring of the twelfth year Jinang gathered a host and encamped within the Loop, intending to strike Yan–Sui; frontier officials were prepared, so he suddenly with fifty thousand horsemen crossed west of the river and attacked the two tribes of Yibulai and Bo'erhai, defeating them greatly.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, spring, Jinang massed his followers inside the Ordos and prepared to strike Yan–Sui; when the frontier officials stood ready, he suddenly crossed the river west with fifty thousand horsemen, fell upon the tribes of Yibulai and Bo'erhai, and routed them.

sentences.zh: 卜兒孩為莊、寧邊患久，亦郎骨、土魯番諸蕃皆苦之，嘗因屬番帖木哥求貢市，朝廷未之許。

translations.literal: Bo'erhai had long been a frontier trouble to Zhuang and Ning; the tribes of Yilanggu, Turfan, and others all suffered from him; they once had the dependent tribesman Tiemuge petition for tribute and trade markets, but the court did not grant it.
translations.idiomatic: Bo'erhai had long plagued the Zhuang and Ning frontiers; the Yilanggu, Turfan, and other tribes all suffered under him; they once had the dependent tribesman Tiemuge ask for tribute and trade markets, but the court refused.

sentences.zh: 至是唐龍以卜兒孩衰敗遠徙，西海獲寧，請無更議款事。

translations.literal: At this Tang Long, because Bo'erhai was decayed and defeated and had moved far away and the Western Sea had gained peace, asked that the matter of peaceful overtures no longer be discussed.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Long now argued that with Bo'erhai broken and driven far off and the Western Sea at peace, the court should stop debating offers of reconciliation.

sentences.zh: 吉囊等既破西海，旋竊入宣府永寧境，大掠而去。

translations.literal: After Jinang and the others had broken the Western Sea tribes, they soon stole into Yongning territory of Xuanfu, plundered greatly, and left.
translations.idiomatic: After crushing the Western Sea tribes, Jinang and his followers slipped into Yongning in Xuanfu, looted heavily, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 冬，犯鎮遠關，總兵王效、副總兵梁震敗之於柳門，又追敗之於蜂窩山，敵溺水死者甚眾。

translations.literal: In winter they raided Zhenyuan Pass; Commander-in-Chief Wang Xiao and Vice Commander Liang Zhen defeated them at Willow Gate, then pursued and defeated them at Beehive Mountain; many enemies drowned.
translations.idiomatic: That winter they struck Zhenyuan Pass; Commander Wang Xiao and Vice Commander Liang Zhen beat them at Willow Gate, pursued them to Beehive Mountain, and drowned many in the rout.

sentences.zh: 明年春，寇大同。

translations.literal: The next spring they raided Datong.
translations.idiomatic: The following spring they hit Datong.

sentences.zh: 秋，復由花馬池入犯，梁震及總兵劉文拒卻之。

translations.literal: In autumn they again entered by Huama Pond; Liang Zhen and Commander-in-Chief Liu Wen repelled them.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn they came in again through Huama Pond; Liang Zhen and Commander Liu Wen drove them back.

sentences.zh: 十五年夏，吉囊以十萬眾屯賀蘭山，分兵寇涼州，副總兵王輔御之，斬五十七級。

translations.literal: In the summer of the fifteenth year Jinang with one hundred thousand men encamped at Mount Helan, divided forces to raid Liangzhou; Vice Commander Wang Fu met them and took fifty-seven heads.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year, summer, Jinang camped one hundred thousand men on Mount Helan and sent detachments against Liangzhou; Vice Commander Wang Fu met them and took fifty-seven heads.

sentences.zh: 又入莊浪境，總兵姜奭遇之於分水嶺，三戰三勝之。

translations.literal: They again entered Zhuanglang territory; Commander-in-Chief Jiang Yi met them at Watershed Ridge and three times fought and three times won.
translations.idiomatic: They entered Zhuanglang again; Commander Jiang Yi met them at Watershed Ridge and won three battles in a row.

sentences.zh: 又入延綏及寧夏邊。

translations.literal: They again entered the Yan–Sui and Ningxia frontiers.
translations.idiomatic: They struck the Yan–Sui and Ningxia borders again.

sentences.zh: 冬，復犯大同，入掠宣大塞，總制侍郎劉天和、總督尚書楊守禮及巡撫都御史楚書悉力御之。

translations.literal: In winter they again raided Datong and entered to plunder the Xuan–Da frontier; Vice Minister and overall commander Liu Tianhe, Governor-General and Minister Yang Shouli, and Censor-in-Chief and Grand Coordinator Chu Shu all defended with full strength.
translations.idiomatic: That winter they raided Datong again and swept the Xuan–Da line; overall commander Liu Tianhe, Governor-General Yang Shouli, and Grand Coordinator Chu Shu threw everything they had into the defense.

sentences.zh: 十九年秋，書以總兵白爵等三敗敵於萬全右衛境，斬百餘級。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the nineteenth year Chu with Commander-in-Chief Bai Jue and others three times defeated the enemy in the territory of Wanquan Right Guard and took more than one hundred heads.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year, autumn, Chu and Commander Bai Jue thrice defeated the enemy in Wanquan Right Guard and took more than one hundred heads.

sentences.zh: 天和以總兵周尚文大破敵於黑水苑，斬吉囊子小十王。

translations.literal: Liu Tianhe with Commander-in-Chief Zhou Shangwen greatly defeated the enemy at Blackwater Park and beheaded Jinang's son Xiaoshi Wang.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Tianhe and Commander Zhou Shangwen routed the enemy at Blackwater Park and killed Jinang's son Xiaoshi Wang.

sentences.zh: 明年春，守禮以總兵李義禦敵於鎮朔堡，以總兵楊信禦敵於甘肅，皆勝之。

translations.literal: The next spring Yang Shouli with Commander-in-Chief Li Yi met the enemy at Zhenshuo Fort and with Commander-in-Chief Yang Xin met the enemy in Gansu; both were victorious.
translations.idiomatic: The following spring Yang Shouli sent Commander Li Yi to meet the enemy at Zhenshuo Fort and Commander Yang Xin to Gansu; both won.

sentences.zh: 秋，俺答及其屬阿不孩遣使石天爵款大同塞，巡撫史道以聞，詔卻之。

translations.literal: In autumn Anda and his follower Abuhai sent the envoy Shi Tianjue to sue for peace at the Datong frontier; Grand Coordinator Shi Dao reported it; an edict rejected them.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn Anda and his follower Abuhai sent Shi Tianjue to offer peace at the Datong frontier; Grand Coordinator Shi Dao reported it, and the court turned them away.

sentences.zh: 以尚書樊繼祖督宣大兵，懸賞格購俺答、阿不孩首。

translations.literal: Minister Fan Jizu was put in charge of Xuan–Da troops and posted reward lists offering purchase of the heads of Anda and Abuhai.
translations.idiomatic: Minister Fan Jizu took command of the Xuan–Da armies and posted bounties for the heads of Anda and Abuhai.

sentences.zh: 遂大舉內犯，俺答下石嶺關，趣太原。

translations.literal: Thereupon they invaded the interior in force; Anda descended Shiling Pass and pressed toward Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: They then invaded in force; Anda came down through Shiling Pass and drove on Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 吉囊田平虜衛入掠平定、壽陽諸處。

translations.literal: Jinang raided through Pinglu Guard into Pingding, Shouyang, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: Jinang came through Pinglu Guard and ravaged Pingding, Shouyang, and the surrounding country.

sentences.zh: 總兵丁璋、游擊周宇戰死，諸將多獲罪，繼祖獨蒙賞。

translations.literal: Commanders-in-Chief Ding Zhang and Mobile Commander Zhou Yu died in battle; many generals were punished; Jizu alone received reward.
translations.idiomatic: Commanders Ding Zhang and Mobile Commander Zhou Yu were killed; many officers were punished, while Jizu alone was rewarded.

sentences.zh: 二十一年夏，敵復遣天爵求貢。

translations.literal: In the summer of the twenty-first year the enemy again sent Tianjue begging tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year, summer, the enemy again sent Tianjue to ask for tribute.

sentences.zh: 大同巡撫龍大有誘縛之，上之朝，詭言用計擒獲。

translations.literal: Datong Grand Coordinator Long Dayou lured and bound him, sent him up to court, and falsely claimed he had been captured by stratagem.
translations.idiomatic: Datong Grand Coordinator Long Dayou tricked and bound him, sent him to court, and falsely claimed a cunning capture.

sentences.zh: 帝悅，擢大有兵部侍郎，邊臣升賞者數十人，磔天爵於市。

translations.literal: The emperor was pleased, promoted Dayou to Vice Minister of War, raised and rewarded several dozen frontier officials, and dismembered Tianjue in the marketplace.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was delighted, promoted Long Dayou to Vice Minister of War, rewarded several dozen frontier officials, and had Tianjue torn apart in the marketplace.

sentences.zh: 敵怒，入寇，掠朔州，抵廣武，由太原南下，沁、汾、襄垣、長子皆被殘；

translations.literal: The enemy grew angry and raided, plundered Shuozhou, reached Guangwu, descended south from Taiyuan; Qin, Fen, Xiangyuan, and Changzi were all ravaged;
translations.idiomatic: Enraged, the raiders swept in, looted Shuozhou, reached Guangwu, and drove south from Taiyuan; Qin, Fen, Xiangyuan, and Changzi were all devastated;

sentences.zh: 復從忻、崞、代而北，屯祁縣。

translations.literal: They again went north by Xin, Guo, and Dai and encamped at Qixian.
translations.idiomatic: They then turned north through Xin, Guo, and Dai and camped at Qixian.

sentences.zh: 參將張世忠力戰，敵圍之數重。

translations.literal: Regimental Commander Zhang Shizhong fought hard; the enemy surrounded him in several rings.
translations.idiomatic: Regimental Commander Zhang Shizhong fought fiercely as the enemy closed round him in layer after layer.

sentences.zh: 自巳至申，所殺傷相當。

translations.literal: From si to shen the slain and wounded on both sides were about equal.
translations.idiomatic: From mid-morning to mid-afternoon the casualties on both sides were roughly even.

sentences.zh: 已而世忠矢盡見殺，百戶張宣、張臣俱死，敵遂從雁門故道去。

translations.literal: Before long Shizhong's arrows were exhausted and he was killed; centurions Zhang Xuan and Zhang Chen both died; the enemy then departed by the old road of Yanmen.
translations.idiomatic: When his arrows ran out Shizhong was killed; centurions Zhang Xuan and Zhang Chen died with him; the raiders then withdrew by the old Yanmen road.

sentences.zh: 秋，復入朔州。

translations.literal: In autumn they again entered Shuozhou.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn they entered Shuozhou again.

sentences.zh: 吉囊死，諸子狼台吉等散處河西，勢既分，俺答獨盛，歲數擾延綏諸邊。

translations.literal: Jinang died; his sons Langtaiji and others scattered in Hexi; their power was divided; Anda alone flourished and for years repeatedly harassed the Yan–Sui frontiers.
translations.idiomatic: When Jinang died his sons Langtaiji and others scattered across Hexi; with their strength divided, Anda alone grew dominant and for years harassed the Yan–Sui border.

sentences.zh: 二十三年冬，小王子自萬全右衛入，至蔚州及完縣。

translations.literal: In the winter of the twenty-third year the Little Prince entered from Wanquan Right Guard and reached Yuzhou and Wancian.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year, winter, the Little Prince came in through Wanquan Right Guard and reached Yuzhou and Wancian.

sentences.zh: 京師戒嚴。

translations.literal: The capital was placed on alert.
translations.idiomatic: The capital went on alert.

sentences.zh: 二十四年秋，俺答犯延綏及大同，總兵張達拒卻之。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the twenty-fourth year Anda raided Yan–Sui and Datong; Commander-in-Chief Zhang Da repelled him.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year, autumn, Anda struck Yan–Sui and Datong; Commander Zhang Da drove him back.

sentences.zh: 又犯鵓鴿峪，參將張鳳、指揮劉欽、千戶李瓚、生員王邦直等皆戰死。

translations.literal: He again raided Boju Valley; Regimental Commander Zhang Feng, Commander Liu Qin, chiliarch Li Zan, licentiate Wang Bangzhi, and others all died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: He struck Boju Valley again; Regimental Commander Zhang Feng, Commander Liu Qin, chiliarch Li Zan, licentiate Wang Bangzhi, and others were all killed.

sentences.zh: 會總督侍郎翁萬達、總兵周尚文嚴兵備陽和，敵引去。

translations.literal: When Governor-General Weng Wanda and Commander-in-Chief Zhou Shangwen rigorously prepared troops at Yanghe, the enemy withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Weng Wanda and Commander Zhou Shangwen then tightened defenses at Yanghe, and the raiders withdrew.

sentences.zh: 明年夏，俺答覆遣使詣大同塞，求貢，邊卒殺之。

translations.literal: The next summer Anda again sent envoys to the Datong frontier begging tribute; frontier soldiers killed them.
translations.idiomatic: The next summer Anda again sent envoys to the Datong frontier to ask for tribute; border soldiers killed them.

sentences.zh: 秋，復來請，萬達再疏以聞，帝不許。

translations.literal: In autumn they came to petition again; Wanda memorialized again; the emperor did not grant it.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn they petitioned again; Wanda memorialized once more, and the emperor again refused.

sentences.zh: 敵以十萬騎西入保安，掠慶陽、環縣而東，以萬騎寇錦、義。

translations.literal: The enemy with one hundred thousand horsemen entered Bao'an from the west, plundered Qingyang and Huanxian and turned east, and with ten thousand horsemen raided Jin and Yi.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy came west into Bao'an with one hundred thousand horsemen, ravaged Qingyang and Huanxian, turned east, and sent ten thousand horsemen against Jin and Yi.

sentences.zh: 總督三邊侍郎曾銑率參將李珍等直搗敵巢於馬梁山後，斬百餘級，敵始退。

translations.literal: Governor-General of the Three Frontiers Zeng Xuan led Regimental Commander Li Zhen and others straight to the enemy's nest behind Mabaliang Mountain, took more than one hundred heads, and only then did the enemy withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General of the Three Frontiers Zeng Xuan led Regimental Commander Li Zhen and others in a direct strike at the enemy base behind Mabaliang Mountain, took more than one hundred heads, and only then did the raiders pull back.

sentences.zh: 銑議復河套，大學士夏言主之。

translations.literal: Zeng proposed recovering the Ordos; Grand Secretary Xia Yan supported it.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng proposed retaking the Ordos, and Grand Secretary Xia Yan backed the plan.

sentences.zh: 帝方向用言，令銑圖上方略，以便宜從事。

translations.literal: The emperor was then inclined to use Yan and ordered Zeng to draft a strategic plan and act at discretion.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was then favoring Yan and told Zeng to draw up a strategy and act as he saw fit.

sentences.zh: 明年夏，萬達復言：「敵自冬涉春屢求貢，詞恭，似宜許。」

translations.literal: The next summer Wanda again said: "The enemy from winter through spring repeatedly begged tribute; their words were respectful; it seems fitting to grant it."
translations.idiomatic: The next summer Wanda wrote again: "Since winter the enemy has repeatedly asked for tribute in respectful terms; it may be wise to grant it."

sentences.zh: 不聽，責萬達罔瀆。

translations.literal: The emperor would not listen and rebuked Wanda for deceit and disrespect.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor refused and rebuked Wanda for deceit and disrespect.

sentences.zh: 銑鳩兵繕塞，輒破敵。

translations.literal: Zeng mustered troops and repaired the frontier walls and repeatedly defeated the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng gathered troops, repaired the frontier defenses, and repeatedly beat the enemy back.

sentences.zh: 既而帝意中變，言與銑竟得罪，斬西市。

translations.literal: Before long the emperor's mind changed midway; Yan and Zeng ultimately were punished and executed at the western market.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the emperor changed his mind; Yan and Zeng were condemned and executed at the western market.

sentences.zh: 敵益蓄忿思逞，廷臣不敢言復套事矣。

translations.literal: The enemy piled up resentment and sought to unleash it; court officials no longer dared speak of recovering the Loop.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy nursed their anger and looked for revenge; at court no one dared speak of retaking the Ordos again.

sentences.zh: 二十八年春，犯宣府滴水崖。

translations.literal: In the spring of the twenty-eighth year they raided Dishui Cliff of Xuanfu.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year, spring, they struck Dishui Cliff in Xuanfu.

sentences.zh: 把總指揮江瀚、董暘戰死，全軍覆，遂犯永寧、大同。

translations.literal: Detachment commanders Jiang Han and Dong Yang died in battle; the whole army was destroyed; they then raided Yongning and Datong.
translations.idiomatic: Detachment commanders Jiang Han and Dong Yang were killed and the whole force wiped out; the raiders then overran Yongning and Datong.

sentences.zh: 總兵周尚文御之於曹家莊，大敗之，斬其魁。

translations.literal: Commander-in-Chief Zhou Shangwen met them at Caojiazhuang and inflicted a great defeat, beheading their leader.
translations.idiomatic: Commander Zhou Shangwen met them at Caojiazhuang, routed them, and beheaded their chieftain.

sentences.zh: 會萬達自懷來赴援，宣府總兵趙國忠聞警，亦率千騎追擊，復連敗之。

translations.literal: Weng Wanda came from Huailai to reinforce; Xuanfu Commander-in-Chief Zhao Guozhong heard the alarm and also led one thousand horsemen in pursuit, again defeating them in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Weng Wanda came from Huailai to reinforce; hearing the alarm, Xuanfu Commander Zhao Guozhong led one thousand horsemen in pursuit and defeated them again and again.

sentences.zh: 是歲，犯西塞者五。

translations.literal: That year there were five raids on the western frontier.
translations.idiomatic: That year the western frontier was hit five times.

sentences.zh: 二十九年春，俺答移駐威寧海子。

translations.literal: In the spring of the twenty-ninth year Anda moved his camp to Weining Lake.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year, spring, Anda shifted his camp to Weining Lake.

sentences.zh: 夏，犯大同，總兵張達、林椿死之。

translations.literal: In summer he raided Datong; Commanders-in-Chief Zhang Da and Lin Chun died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: That summer he struck Datong; Commanders Zhang Da and Lin Chun were killed.

sentences.zh: 敵引去，傳箭諸部大舉。

translations.literal: The enemy withdrew but passed the arrow among the tribes for a major mobilization.
translations.idiomatic: The raiders withdrew, but sent the arrow round the tribes for a full mobilization.

sentences.zh: 秋，循潮河川南下至古北口，都御史王汝孝率薊鎮兵御之。

translations.literal: In autumn they followed the Chaohu River south to Gubeikou; Censor-in-Chief Wang Ruxiao led Ji garrison troops to meet them.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn they followed the Chaohu River south to Gubeikou; Censor-in-Chief Wang Ruxiao led the Ji garrison troops to meet them.

sentences.zh: 敵陽引滿內向，而別遣精騎從間道潰牆入。

translations.literal: The enemy feigned drawing bows inward while separately sending picked horsemen through a bypath to break through the wall and enter.
translations.idiomatic: The raiders feigned a frontal advance with bows drawn while elite horsemen slipped through a bypath and broke the wall.

sentences.zh: 汝孝兵潰，遂大掠懷柔，圍順義，抵通州，分兵四掠，焚湖渠馬房。

translations.literal: Ruxiao's troops collapsed; they then plundered Huairou greatly, besieged Shunyi, reached Tongzhou, divided forces to raid in four directions, and burned the canal stable yards.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ruxiao's army broke; the raiders looted Huairou, besieged Shunyi, reached Tongzhou, fanned out in four directions, and burned the canal horse yards.

sentences.zh: 畿甸大震。

translations.literal: The capital region was greatly shaken.
translations.idiomatic: The capital region was thrown into panic.

sentences.zh: 敵大眾犯京師，大同總兵咸寧侯仇鸞、巡撫保定都御史楊守謙等，各以勤王兵至。

translations.literal: The enemy in great numbers threatened the capital; Datong Commander and Marquis of Xianning Qiu Luan, Baoding Censor-in-Chief and Grand Coordinator Yang Shouqian, and others each arrived with troops to relieve the throne.
translations.idiomatic: A great enemy force threatened the capital; Datong Commander and Marquis of Xianning Qiu Luan, Baoding Grand Coordinator Yang Shouqian, and others each arrived with armies to save the throne.

sentences.zh: 帝拜鸞為大將軍，使護諸軍。

translations.literal: The emperor invested Luan as grand general and had him protect all the armies.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor made Qiu Luan grand general and put all the armies under his command.

sentences.zh: 鸞與守謙皆軿懦不敢戰，兵部尚書丁汝夔忄匡擾不知所為，閉門守。

translations.literal: Luan and Shouqian were both cowardly and dared not fight; Minister of War Ding Ruokui was panic-stricken and did not know what to do, and shut the gates to hold defense.
translations.idiomatic: Qiu Luan and Yang Shouqian were both too timid to fight; Minister of War Ding Ruokui lost his head and shut the gates in a purely defensive stand.

sentences.zh: 敵焚掠三日夜，引去。

translations.literal: The enemy burned and plundered for three days and nights and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: The raiders burned and looted for three days and nights, then withdrew.

sentences.zh: 帝誅汝夔及守謙。

translations.literal: The emperor executed Ruokui and Shouqian.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor had Ruokui and Shouqian executed.

sentences.zh: 敵將出白羊口，鸞尾之。

translations.literal: As the enemy was about to exit Baiyang Pass, Luan followed on their tail.
translations.idiomatic: As the raiders were about to leave by Baiyang Pass, Qiu Luan followed at their heels.

sentences.zh: 敵猝東返，鸞出不意，兵潰，死傷千餘人。

translations.literal: The enemy suddenly turned back east; Luan was caught off guard; his troops collapsed and more than a thousand were killed or wounded.
translations.idiomatic: The raiders suddenly wheeled east; caught off guard, Qiu Luan's force broke; more than a thousand were killed or wounded.

sentences.zh: 敵乃徐由古北口出塞。

translations.literal: The enemy then slowly exited the frontier through Gubeikou.
translations.idiomatic: The raiders then withdrew unhurriedly through Gubeikou and left the frontier.

sentences.zh: 諸將收斬遺屍，得八十餘級，以捷聞。

translations.literal: The generals gathered and beheaded the bodies left behind, obtaining more than eighty heads, and reported a victory.
translations.idiomatic: The generals collected the slain left behind and took more than eighty heads, then reported a victory.

sentences.zh: 方俺答薄都城時，縱所擄馬房內官楊增持書入城求貢。

translations.literal: Just as Altan Khan was pressing close to the capital, he released the eunuch Yang Zeng of the horse stables whom he had captured, sending him with a letter into the city to request tribute.
translations.idiomatic: While Altan Khan was closing on the capital, he sent in the captured stable eunuch Yang Zeng with a letter asking for tribute.

sentences.zh: 輔臣徐階等謂當以計款之，諭令退屯塞外，因邊臣以請。

translations.literal: Chief ministers such as Xu Jie said they should use stratagem to treat him sincerely, instruct him to withdraw and encamp beyond the frontier, and have frontier officials submit the request.
translations.idiomatic: Chief ministers such as Xu Jie argued that they should placate him by design, tell him to withdraw beyond the frontier, and let border officials submit the tribute request.

sentences.zh: 俺答歸，遣子脫脫陳款。

translations.literal: Altan Khan returned and sent his son Toto to present sincere terms.
translations.idiomatic: Altan Khan withdrew and sent his son Toto to offer peace.

sentences.zh: 時鸞方用事，乃議開馬市以中敵。

translations.literal: At that time Luan was just in power, so they proposed opening a horse market to hit the enemy's aim.
translations.idiomatic: Qiu Luan was then in power, and the court proposed opening a horse market—playing straight into the enemy's hands.

sentences.zh: 兵部郎中楊繼盛上疏爭之，不得。

translations.literal: Yang Jisheng, a director in the Ministry of War, submitted a memorial arguing against it, but did not prevail.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Jisheng of the Ministry of War memorialized against the plan, but in vain.

sentences.zh: 明年春，以侍郎史道蒞其事，給白金十萬，開市大同，次及延、寧。

translations.literal: The next spring Vice Minister Shi Dao was sent to oversee the matter; one hundred thousand taels of silver were granted, and markets were opened at Datong, then at Yan–Sui and Ningxia.
translations.idiomatic: The following spring Vice Minister Shi Dao was put in charge; the court allotted one hundred thousand taels of silver and opened markets at Datong, then at Yan–Sui and Ningxia.

sentences.zh: 叛人蕭芹、呂明鎮者，故以罪亡入敵，挾白蓮邪教，與其黨趙全、丘富、周原、喬源諸人導俺答為患。

translations.literal: The defectors Xiao Qin and Lü Mingzhen had formerly fled into the enemy because of crimes; carrying the White Lotus heterodox teaching, they and their followers Zhao Quan, Qiu Fu, Zhou Yuan, Qiao Yuan, and others guided Altan Khan in making trouble.
translations.idiomatic: Two defectors, Xiao Qin and Lü Mingzhen, had fled to the enemy after criminal convictions; armed with White Lotus teachings, they and their followers Zhao Quan, Qiu Fu, Zhou Yuan, and Qiao Yuan steered Altan Khan into raiding.

sentences.zh: 俺答市畢，旋入掠。

translations.literal: When Altan Khan's market dealings were finished, he immediately entered to raid.
translations.idiomatic: As soon as the horse trade ended, Altan Khan turned to raiding again.

sentences.zh: 邊臣責之，以芹等為詞。

translations.literal: Frontier officials reproached him, using Qin and the others as their excuse.
translations.idiomatic: Border officials reproached him, blaming the raids on Qin and his associates.

sentences.zh: 芹詭有術，能墮城。

translations.literal: Qin falsely claimed to have a technique that could bring down cities.
translations.idiomatic: Qin claimed he possessed arts that could breach city walls.

sentences.zh: 敵試之不驗，遂縛芹及明鎮，而全、富等竟匿不出。

translations.literal: The enemy tested it and it did not work, so they bound Qin and Mingzhen, while Quan, Fu, and the others in the end hid and would not come out.
translations.idiomatic: The Mongols tried the method and it failed, so they bound Qin and Mingzhen; Quan, Fu, and the others stayed hidden and refused to surrender.

sentences.zh: 俺答覆請以牛馬易粟豆，求職役誥敕，又潛約河西諸部內犯，墮諸邊垣。

translations.literal: Altan Khan again asked to exchange cattle and horses for grain and beans, sought patents of appointment for official service, and secretly agreed with the Hexi tribes to invade inward and breach the border walls.
translations.idiomatic: Altan Khan again asked to trade horses and cattle for grain and beans, sought Ming patents of office, and secretly arranged with the Hexi tribes to raid inward and break the frontier walls.

sentences.zh: 帝惡之，詔罷馬市，召道還。

translations.literal: The emperor detested this and ordered the horse market abolished and Dao recalled.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was disgusted and ordered the horse market closed and Shi Dao recalled.

sentences.zh: 自是，敵日寇掠西邊，邊人大困。

translations.literal: From this time the enemy raided and plundered the western frontier day after day, and the border people were greatly distressed.
translations.idiomatic: From then on the raiders pillaged the western frontier almost daily, and the border population was driven to desperation.

sentences.zh: 三十一年春，敵二千騎寇大同，指揮王恭御之於平川墩，戰死。

translations.literal: In the spring of the thirty-first year two thousand enemy horsemen raided Datong; Commander Wang Gong met them at Pingchuan Stockade and died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year, spring, two thousand raiders struck Datong; Commander Wang Gong met them at Pingchuan Stockade and was killed.

sentences.zh: 夏，東入遼塞，圍百戶常祿，指揮姚大謨、劉棟、劉啟基等於三道氵冓，四人皆戰沒。

translations.literal: In summer they entered the Liaodong frontier from the east, besieged Company Commander Chang Lu, and surrounded Commanders Yao Damo, Liu Dong, Liu Qiji, and others at Sandao Gully; all four died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: That summer they entered the Liaodong frontier from the east, besieged Company Commander Chang Lu, and trapped Commanders Yao Damo, Liu Dong, and Liu Qiji at Sandao Gully; all four were killed.

sentences.zh: 備御指揮王相赴援，大戰於寺兒山，殺傷相當，敵捨去。

translations.literal: Defense Commander Wang Xiang went to reinforce them and fought a great battle at Si'er Mountain; casualties were about equal, and the enemy broke off and left.
translations.idiomatic: Defense Commander Wang Xiang marched to their aid and fought a fierce battle at Si'er Mountain; casualties were roughly even, and the raiders withdrew.

sentences.zh: 千戶葉廷瑞率百人助相。

translations.literal: Battalion Commander Ye Tingrui led one hundred men to assist Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: Battalion Commander Ye Tingrui brought one hundred men to Wang Xiang's aid.

sentences.zh: 明日，相裹創復邀敵於蠟黎山，殊死鬥，矢竭，遂與麾下將士三百人皆死之。

translations.literal: The next day Xiang, binding his wounds, again intercepted the enemy at Lali Mountain and fought to the death; when his arrows were exhausted, he and the three hundred officers and soldiers under his command all died.
translations.idiomatic: The next day Wang Xiang, wounds bound, intercepted the enemy again at Lali Mountain and fought to the death; when his arrows ran out, he and his three hundred officers and men all perished.

sentences.zh: 廷瑞被創死復甦，敵亦引退。

translations.literal: Tingrui was wounded and died, then revived; the enemy also withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Tingrui was wounded to the point of death but recovered; the raiders also pulled back.

sentences.zh: 其年，凡四犯大同，三犯遼陽，一犯寧夏。

translations.literal: That year there were in all four raids on Datong, three on Liaoyang, and one on Ningxia.
translations.idiomatic: That year they struck Datong four times, Liaoyang three times, and Ningxia once.

sentences.zh: 明年春，犯宣府及延綏。

translations.literal: The next spring they raided Xuanfu and Yan–Sui.
translations.idiomatic: The following spring they hit Xuanfu and Yan–Sui.

sentences.zh: 夏，犯甘肅及大同。

translations.literal: In summer they raided Gansu and Datong.
translations.idiomatic: That summer they struck Gansu and Datong.

sentences.zh: 守將御之輒敗。

translations.literal: The defending generals met them and were repeatedly defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Every defending commander who met them was beaten.

sentences.zh: 秋，俺答覆大舉入寇，下渾源、靈丘、廣昌，急攻插箭、浮圖等峪。

translations.literal: In autumn Altan Khan again invaded in force, took Hunyuan, Lingqiu, and Guangchang, and urgently attacked the passes of Chajian, Futu, and others.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn Altan Khan invaded again in force, overran Hunyuan, Lingqiu, and Guangchang, and pressed hard on the passes at Chajian, Futu, and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 固原游擊陳鳳、寧夏游擊硃玉率兵赴援，大戰卻之。

translations.literal: Guyuan Brigadier Chen Feng and Ningxia Brigadier Zhu Yu led troops to reinforce them, fought a great battle, and drove the enemy back.
translations.idiomatic: Brigadiers Chen Feng of Guyuan and Zhu Yu of Ningxia marched to reinforce them, fought a major battle, and drove the raiders off.

sentences.zh: 敵分兵東犯蔚，西掠代、繁畤。

translations.literal: The enemy divided their forces, raiding Yu in the east and plundering Dai and Fanzhi in the west.
translations.idiomatic: The raiders split their forces, striking Yu in the east and looting Dai and Fanzhi in the west.

sentences.zh: 已，駐鹿阝、延二十日，延慶諸城屠掠幾遍，乃移營中部，以瞰涇、原，會久雨乃去。

translations.literal: Then they encamped at Lu and Yan for twenty days, slaughtering and plundering nearly every city of Yanqing; afterward they moved camp to the central region to overlook Jing and Yuan, and left only when the rains lasted long.
translations.idiomatic: They then encamped in the Lu and Yan region for twenty days and looted almost every town in Yanqing before shifting camp to the central frontier to threaten Jing and Yuan; only prolonged rain made them withdraw.

sentences.zh: 時小王子亦乘隙為寇，犯宣府赤城。

translations.literal: At that time the Little Prince also seized the opportunity to raid and struck Chicheng in Xuanfu.
translations.idiomatic: The Little Prince also took advantage of the moment to raid, striking Chicheng in Xuanfu.

sentences.zh: 未幾，俺答覆以萬騎入大同，縱掠至八角堡。

translations.literal: Before long Altan Khan again entered Datong with ten thousand horsemen and plundered freely as far as Bajiao Fort.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Altan Khan returned with ten thousand horsemen, swept through Datong, and looted as far as Bajiao Fort.

sentences.zh: 巡撫趙時春御之，遇敵於大蟲嶺，總兵李淶戰死，軍覆，時春僅以身免。

translations.literal: Grand Coordinator Zhao Shichun met them, encountered the enemy at Dachong Ridge; Commander-in-Chief Li Lai died in battle, the army was destroyed, and Shichun barely escaped with his life.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coordinator Zhao Shichun went to meet them and clashed at Dachong Ridge; Commander Li Lai was killed, the army was wiped out, and Zhao Shichun escaped only with his life.

sentences.zh: 三十三年春，入宣府柴溝堡。

translations.literal: In the spring of the thirty-third year they entered Chaigou Fort of Xuanfu.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-third year, spring, they entered Chaigou Fort in Xuanfu.

sentences.zh: 夏，復犯寧夏，大同總兵岳懋中伏死。

translations.literal: In summer they again raided Ningxia; Datong Commander-in-Chief Yue Maozhong died in an ambush.
translations.idiomatic: That summer they struck Ningxia again; Datong Commander Yue Maozhong was killed in an ambush.

sentences.zh: 秋，攻薊鎮牆，百道並進。

translations.literal: In autumn they attacked the Ji garrison wall on a hundred fronts at once.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn they assaulted the Ji frontier wall from a hundred directions at once.

sentences.zh: 警報日數十至，京師戒嚴。

translations.literal: Alarm reports arrived by the dozens each day, and the capital was placed under martial alert.
translations.idiomatic: Alarm reports arrived by the dozen each day, and the capital went on full alert.

sentences.zh: 總督楊博悉力拒守，募死士夜砍其營，敵驚擾乃遁。

translations.literal: Governor-General Yang Bo exerted all his strength in defense, recruited daredevils to cut into their camp by night, and the enemy, startled and thrown into disorder, then fled.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Yang Bo defended with all his strength, sent volunteers to strike their camp by night, and the startled raiders broke off and fled.

sentences.zh: 明年數犯宣、薊，參將趙傾葵、李光啟、丁碧先後戰死。

translations.literal: The next year they raided Xuan and Ji several times; Regimental Commanders Zhao Qingkui, Li Guangqi, and Ding Bi died in battle one after another.
translations.idiomatic: The following year they struck Xuan and Ji repeatedly; Regimental Commanders Zhao Qingkui, Li Guangqi, and Ding Bi were killed in turn.

sentences.zh: 朝廷再下賞格，購俺答首，賜萬金，爵伯；

translations.literal: The court again issued bounty notices, offering payment for Altan Khan's head with ten thousand in gold and ennoblement as a marquis.
translations.idiomatic: The court posted fresh bounties for Altan Khan's head—ten thousand in gold and a marquisate.

sentences.zh: 獲丘富、周原者三百金，授三品武階。

translations.literal: For capturing Qiu Fu and Zhou Yuan there were three hundred in gold and appointment to the third military rank.
translations.idiomatic: Capture of Qiu Fu or Zhou Yuan would bring three hundred taels of gold and a third-grade military commission.

sentences.zh: 時富等在敵，招集亡命，居豐州，築城自衛，構宮殿，墾水田，號曰板升。

translations.literal: At that time Fu and the others were with the enemy; they gathered fugitives, dwelt at Fengzhou, built a city to protect themselves, erected palaces, opened irrigated fields, and styled the place Ban Sheng.
translations.idiomatic: Fu and his fellows were then with the enemy; they gathered outlaws, settled at Fengzhou, walled a town, built palaces, opened irrigated fields, and called the settlement Paising.

sentences.zh: 板升，華言屋也。

translations.literal: Ban Sheng—in Chinese parlance, means 'house.'
translations.idiomatic: Paising is glossed in Chinese as 'house.'

sentences.zh: 趙全教敵，益習攻戰事。

translations.literal: Zhao Quan instructed the enemy, who grew ever more skilled in assault and battle.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Quan trained the Mongols, who grew ever more adept at siege and war.

sentences.zh: 俺答愛之甚，每入寇必置酒全所問計。

translations.literal: Altan Khan loved him greatly; every time he raided he would set out wine at Quan's place and ask his plans.
translations.idiomatic: Altan Khan valued him highly; before every raid he would feast at Quan's home and ask his counsel.

sentences.zh: 三十五年夏，敵三萬騎犯宣府。

translations.literal: In the summer of the thirty-fifth year thirty thousand enemy horsemen raided Xuanfu.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fifth year, summer, thirty thousand raiders struck Xuanfu.

sentences.zh: 游擊張紘迎戰，敗死。

translations.literal: Brigadier Zhang Hong met them in battle, was defeated, and died.
translations.idiomatic: Brigadier Zhang Hong met them in battle and was killed in defeat.

sentences.zh: 冬，掠大同邊，繼掠陝西環、慶諸處，守將孫朝、袁正等卻之。

translations.literal: In winter they plundered the Datong frontier, then plundered Huan, Qing, and other places in Shaanxi; defending generals Sun Chao and Yuan Zheng drove them back.
translations.idiomatic: That winter they looted the Datong frontier and then Huan, Qing, and other districts in Shaanxi; Generals Sun Chao and Yuan Zheng drove them off.

sentences.zh: 其年，土蠻再犯遼東。

translations.literal: That year Tümen again raided Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: That year Tümen raided Liaodong again.

sentences.zh: 明年，敵以二萬騎分掠大同邊，殺守備唐天祿、把總汪淵。

translations.literal: The next year the enemy with twenty thousand horsemen divided forces to plunder the Datong frontier and killed Defense Commander Tang Tianlu and Detachment Commander Wang Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: The next year twenty thousand raiders split up to loot the Datong frontier, killing Defense Commander Tang Tianlu and Detachment Commander Wang Yuan.

sentences.zh: 俺答弟老把都復擁眾數萬入河流口，犯永平及遷安，副總兵蔣承勳力戰死。

translations.literal: Altan Khan's younger brother La Bato again gathered a host of tens of thousands, entered at Heiliukou, and raided Yongping and Qian'an; Vice Commander-in-Chief Jiang Chengxun fought hard and died.
translations.idiomatic: Altan Khan's brother La Bato massed tens of thousands again, entered at Heiliukou, and struck Yongping and Qian'an; Vice Commander Jiang Chengxun fought to the death.

sentences.zh: 夏，突犯宣府馬尾梁，參將祁勉戰死。

translations.literal: In summer they suddenly raided Maweiliang in Xuanfu; Regimental Commander Qi Mian died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: That summer they suddenly struck Maweiliang in Xuanfu; Regimental Commander Qi Mian was killed.

sentences.zh: 秋，復入大同右衛境，攻毀七十餘堡，所殺擄甚眾。

translations.literal: In autumn they again entered the territory of Datong Right Guard, attacked and destroyed more than seventy forts, and killed and captured a great many people.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn they entered Datong Right Guard again, destroyed more than seventy forts, and killed or captured a great many people.

sentences.zh: 冬，俺答子辛愛有妾曰桃松寨，私部目收令哥，懼誅來降。

translations.literal: In winter Altan Khan's son Engi had a concubine called Taosongzhai who had secretly taken the company officer Shoulingge; fearing execution, she came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: That winter Engi, Altan Khan's son, had a concubine named Taosongzhai who had secretly taken up with the company officer Shoulingge; fearing punishment, she defected.

sentences.zh: 總督楊順自詡為奇功，致之闕下。

translations.literal: Governor-General Yang Shun boasted of it as a singular achievement and had her brought to the imperial court.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Yang Shun touted it as a singular coup and sent her to the capital.

sentences.zh: 辛愛來索不得，乃縱掠大同諸墩堡，圍右衛數匝。

translations.literal: Engi came to demand her back and could not obtain her, so he plundered freely among the stockades and forts of Datong and surrounded Right Guard many times over.
translations.idiomatic: Engi came to reclaim her in vain, then looted Datong's stockades and forts and ringed Right Guard again and again.

sentences.zh: 順懼，乃詭言敵願易我以趙全、丘富。

translations.literal: Shun was afraid and falsely claimed the enemy wished to exchange her for Zhao Quan and Qiu Fu.
translations.idiomatic: Frightened, Shun lied that the enemy would trade her for Zhao Quan and Qiu Fu.

sentences.zh: 本兵許論以為便，乃遣桃松寨夜逸出塞，紿之西走，陰告辛愛，辛愛執而戮之。

translations.literal: Minister of War Xu Lun thought it expedient; they then sent Taosongzhai to slip out of the frontier by night, deceived her into fleeing west, secretly informed Engi, and Engi seized and executed her.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of War Xu Lun approved the scheme; they sent Taosongzhai out of the frontier by night, tricked her into fleeing west, secretly tipped off Engi, and he seized and killed her.

sentences.zh: 敵狎知順無能，圍右衛益急，更分兵犯宣、薊鎮。

translations.literal: The enemy, having grown familiar with Shun's incompetence, pressed the siege of Right Guard ever harder and further divided forces to raid the Xuan and Ji garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: Having learned how useless Shun was, the raiders tightened the siege of Right Guard and sent detachments against the Xuan and Ji garrisons.

sentences.zh: 西鄙震動，右衛烽火斷絕者六閱月。

translations.literal: The western frontier was shaken; the beacon fires of Right Guard were cut off for six months.
translations.idiomatic: The western frontier was thrown into turmoil; Right Guard's beacon chain went dark for six months.

sentences.zh: 大學士嚴嵩與許論議，欲棄右衛。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Yan Song and Xu Lun discussed abandoning Right Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Yan Song and Xu Lun debated giving up Right Guard.

sentences.zh: 帝不聽，詔諸臣發兵措餉，而以兵部侍郎江東代順。

translations.literal: The emperor would not listen and ordered the officials to dispatch troops and arrange supplies, replacing Shun with Vice Minister of War Jiang Dong.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor refused and ordered officials to raise troops and funds, replacing Shun with Vice Minister of War Jiang Dong.

sentences.zh: 時故將尚表以饋餉入圍城，悉力捍禦，粟盡食牛馬，徹屋為薪，士卒無變志。

translations.literal: At that time the veteran general Shang Biao entered the besieged city with supplies, defended with all his strength, and when grain was exhausted ate cattle and horses, tore down houses for firewood, yet the soldiers did not change their resolve.
translations.idiomatic: The veteran Shang Biao had entered the besieged city with supplies and defended with all his strength; when grain ran out they ate horses and cattle and burned houses for fuel, yet the garrison never wavered.

sentences.zh: 表時出兵突戰，獲俺答孫及婿與其部將各一人。

translations.literal: From time to time Biao sallied out in sudden battle and captured one of Altan Khan's grandsons, one son-in-law, and one of his tribal generals.
translations.idiomatic: Biao made repeated sorties and captured one of Altan Khan's grandsons, a son-in-law, and a tribal general.

sentences.zh: 會帝所遣侍郎江東及巡撫楊選、總兵張承勳等各嚴兵進，圍乃解。

translations.literal: Just then Vice Minister Jiang Dong sent by the emperor, Grand Coordinator Yang Xuan, Commander-in-Chief Zhang Chengxun, and others each advanced with strict military force, and the siege was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: Then Vice Minister Jiang Dong, Grand Coordinator Yang Xuan, Commander Zhang Chengxun, and the other relief forces advanced in strength, and the siege was broken.

sentences.zh: 復掠永昌、涼州及宣府赤城，圍甘州十四日始退。

translations.literal: They again plundered Yongchang, Liangzhou, and Chicheng in Xuanfu, and besieged Ganzhou for fourteen days before withdrawing.
translations.idiomatic: They looted Yongchang, Liangzhou, and Chicheng in Xuanfu, besieged Ganzhou for fourteen days, and then withdrew.

sentences.zh: 土蠻亦數寇遼東。

translations.literal: Tümen also raided Liaodong several times.
translations.idiomatic: Tümen also struck Liaodong repeatedly.

sentences.zh: 三十八年春，老把都、辛愛謀大舉入犯，駐會州，使其諜詭稱東下。

translations.literal: In the spring of the thirty-eighth year La Bato and Engi plotted a major invasion, encamped at Huizhou, and had their spies falsely claim they were moving east.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-eighth year, spring, La Bato and Engi planned a major invasion, camped at Huizhou, and sent spies to spread word that they were heading east.

sentences.zh: 總督王忬不能察，遽分兵而東，號令數易，敵遂乘間入薊鎮潘家口，忬得罪。

translations.literal: Governor-General Wang Yu could not discern the ruse, hastily divided his forces eastward, and changed orders several times; the enemy then seized the opening to enter Panjiakou of the Ji garrison, and Yu was punished.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Wang Yu failed to see through the deception, hurriedly split his forces east, and changed orders repeatedly; the raiders slipped through Panjiakou in the Ji garrison, and Wang Yu was punished.

sentences.zh: 夏，犯大同，轉掠宣府東西二城，駐內地旬日，會久雨乃退。

translations.literal: In summer they raided Datong, then turned to plunder the eastern and western cities of Xuanfu, encamped within the interior for ten days, and withdrew only when the rains lasted long.
translations.idiomatic: That summer they struck Datong, then turned to loot the eastern and western districts of Xuanfu, camped inside the frontier for ten days, and withdrew only after prolonged rain.

sentences.zh: 三十九年，敵聚眾喜峰口外，窺犯薊鎮。

translations.literal: In the thirty-ninth year the enemy gathered a host outside Xifeng Pass and watched for an opportunity to raid the Ji garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-ninth year the raiders massed outside Xifeng Pass, poised to strike the Ji frontier.

sentences.zh: 大同總兵劉漢出搗其帳於灰河，敵稍遠徙。

translations.literal: Datong Commander-in-Chief Liu Han went out and struck their camp at Huihe; the enemy moved somewhat farther away.
translations.idiomatic: Datong Commander Liu Han raided their camp at Huihe and forced them to pull back.

sentences.zh: 秋，漢復與參將王孟夏等搗豐州，擒斬一百五十人，焚板升略盡。

translations.literal: In autumn Han again, with Regimental Commander Wang Mengxia and others, struck Fengzhou, captured and beheaded one hundred fifty men, and burned Paising nearly to completion.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn Liu Han, with Regimental Commander Wang Mengxia and others, raided Fengzhou, killed one hundred fifty men, and burned Paising nearly to the ground.

sentences.zh: 是歲，寇大同、延綏、薊、遼邊無虛日。

translations.literal: That year raids on the frontiers of Datong, Yan–Sui, Ji, and Liaodong left scarcely a day free.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Datong, Yan–Sui, Ji, and Liaodong frontiers were hit almost every day.

sentences.zh: 明年春，敵自河西踏冰入寇，守備王世臣、千戶李虎戰死。

translations.literal: The next spring the enemy crossed the ice from Hexi to raid; Defense Commander Wang Shichen and Battalion Commander Li Hu died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: The following spring the raiders crossed the frozen river from Hexi; Defense Commander Wang Shichen and Battalion Commander Li Hu were killed.

sentences.zh: 秋，犯宣府及居庸。

translations.literal: In autumn they raided Xuanfu and Juyong.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn they struck Xuanfu and Juyong.

sentences.zh: 冬，掠陝西、寧夏塞。

translations.literal: In winter they plundered the frontiers of Shaanxi and Ningxia.
translations.idiomatic: That winter they looted the Shaanxi and Ningxia frontier.

sentences.zh: 已，復分兵而東，陷蓋州。

translations.literal: Then they again divided forces eastward and took Gaizhou.
translations.idiomatic: They then split a force eastward and captured Gaizhou.

sentences.zh: 四十一年夏，土蠻入撫順，為總兵黑春所敗。

translations.literal: In the summer of the forty-first year Tümen entered Fushun and was defeated by Commander-in-Chief Hei Chun.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-first year, summer, Tümen entered Fushun and was beaten by Commander Hei Chun.

sentences.zh: 冬，復攻鳳凰城，春力戰二日夜，死之。

translations.literal: In winter they again attacked Fenghuang City; Chun fought hard for two days and nights and died.
